summary: Outset Medical filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to an existing purchasing agreement with HCA to refresh the fleet of Tablo Hemodialysis Systems. The amendment commits HCA to purchase new systems from 2026 through 2028 for approximately $40 million aggregate contract value, net of rebates. This is a routine commercial contract update, not a special situation. The company also reiterated prior 2026 guidance with no material corporate event triggering a special-situation classification.
